entities.name: Glimmer Vale
entities.description: A small vale in Kjeldor's hinterlands at the foot of Raynor Glacier, glittering with mica.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Stole back Jodah's mirror and went to Glimmer Vale.

entities.name: Belenda Danisdotter
entities.description: Skyknight who carried Jaya to Glimmer Vale.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Was being cared for in Glimmer Vale.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Held Jodah's mirror in the Royal Academy of Magic.

events.summary: Jaya Ballard stole back Jodah's mirror from Gustha Ebbasdotter in Krov.
events.quote: After stealing back Jodah's mirror from Gustha Ebbasdotter in the Royal Academy of Magic in Krov
